problem_markdown: Let $p_n(k)$ count permutations of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with exactly $k$ fixed points. Prove $\sum_{k=0}^n k\,p_n(k)=n!$.
solutions_markdown: Count pairs $(\sigma,i)$ where $\sigma$ is a permutation and $\sigma(i)=i$. Grouping by the permutation gives $\sum k\,p_n(k)$. Choosing $i$ first gives $n$ choices and then $(n-1)!$ permutations of the other elements. Hence the same count is $n(n-1)!=n!$.
